exec: SANA reports a new breach of Denmark's civil registry gave unauthorised parties access to personal data of 11 thousand people, two months after an earlier one.
geo_basis: country: SANA reports the Danish government announcement from Copenhagen; the civil registry is a national system
plain: SANA reports Denmark's government announced a new cyberattack on the national civil registry. Unauthorised parties reached the personal data of 11 thousand people. The administration says it detected and stopped it.

sources.name: SANA Arabic: new breach of the Danish civil registry affects data of 11 thousand people

summary: SANA reports the Danish government announced a new cyberattack on the national civil registry that gave unauthorised parties access to the personal data of 11 thousand people. According to SANA, the Ministry of Digital Affairs says the registry's administration detected the new breach and stopped it. SANA says it came two months after an earlier attack on the registry.
title: Denmark reports new civil registry breach exposing data of 11 thousand people, SANA reports
